I'm sorry.|Dane to [[Maximus]] about their choice to injure themself}} '''Dane''' is a member of the [[Knights of San Fernando]], a chapter of the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] operating in the greater [[Los Angeles]] area in [[Timeline#2296|2296]]. They appear {{In|FOTV}}. Dane is the first known [[LGBT representation in the Fallout series|non-binary]] member of the Brotherhood in the ''Fallout'' series. ==Background== Nothing is known about Dane's history save for that they were not born into the Brotherhood of Steel, though how and when they were recruited is also unknown. In their military career, Dane has experienced living in the wasteland and knows the worst of how humanity can be. In joining the Brotherhood of Steel, Dane was attracted to the idea of having "brothers" and "sisters" that supported each other, and values in learning about technology. With Maximus, Dane is attracted to their fellow aspirant's fortitude and has sympathy towards him over his misgivings at failing to become a knight as they both dreamed, seemingly serving as his only close relationship in the organization.[https://youtu.be/3zPyFNwwBlQ?t=2013 Collider interview] ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===Season 1=== {{Quotation|Dane is a confident and eager Initiate of the Brotherhood of Steel, and [[Maximus]]'s closest peer. They believe in the mission of the Brotherhood and dream of one day suiting up as a Knight.|[[Fallout season 1 Amazon overview|''Fallout'' season 1 character description]]}} ====[[The End (episode)|The End]]==== [[File:FOTV BoS Base Clinic.png|thumb|left|200px|Maximus visits Dane in the camp clinic]] By [[Timeline#2296|2296]], Dane resides with the rest of their chapter at the Knights of San Fernando's [[Brotherhood base|main base]] somewhere on the West Coast. They are also the only friend Maximus apparently has among his fellow aspirants, whereas most others readily join in with [[Thaddeus]] in physically harassing and belittling Maximus. After the arrival of knights from the [[Brotherhood of Steel (Fallout 4)|Commonwealth chapter]] on the [[East Coast]], Dane ends up being among those selected for promotion to [[Brotherhood squire|squire]] under [[Titus|Knight Titus]], which Maxmius privately envies. However, shortly after, Dane is injured by a razor blade hidden in their boot that ends up maiming their ankle and incapacitating them. While some accused Maximus of orchestrating the incident out of jealousy for Dane's promotion, Dane themselves expresses that they don't believe those rumors about him. As a result of Dane's incapacitation, Maximus is chosen to take their place as Titus' squire during the manhunt for [[Siggi Wilzig]].{{FOTV|1|1}} ====[[The Beginning]]==== [[File:Dane The Beginning.png|thumb|200px|Dane seeing Maximus return]] When Maximus returns to the Brotherhood, Dane is shown to have recovered from their wound and now wears a [[scribe (TV series)|scribe]] uniform rather than that of a squire. Dane observes as Maximus reveals the death of Knight Titus and presents Elder Cleric [[Quintus]] with a [[critic|fake head]] posing as that of the target. After discovering the deception due to the head lacking the [[cold fusion]] device, Quintus accuses Maximus of lying about the artifact just as he lied about his culpability in Dane's maiming. When Quintus prepares to order Maximus' execution for treason, Dane interjects, confessing that their injury was self-inflicted and pleads that Elder Quintus listen to Maximus for the sake of the Brotherhood, which the Elder grants while commending such a rare display of loyalty from a member of the Brotherhood. Dane later confesses to Maximus the truth about how they deliberately maimed themselves with the razor blade, stating they feared dying horribly in the wasteland, and apologizes for the trouble it caused him as a result. Maximus forgives Dane, alluding to the fact that he never would have met [[Lucy MacLean]] if he had not become a squire. Maximus then confesses his intention to return to [[Vault 33]] with Lucy, with Dane warning their friend that nowhere is safe from violence in the wasteland and that leaving the Brotherhood is not an option.{{FOTV|1|8}} [[File:Maximus Dane battle.png|thumb|left|200px|Dane and Maximus during the [[Battle of Griffith Observatory]]]] Dane gears up and accompanies Maximus during the Brotherhood's [[Battle of Griffith Observatory|assault]] on the [[Griffith Observatory]] occupied by [[Lee Moldaver]] and the remnants of the [[New California Republic]] from [[Los Angeles]] with the aim of taking control of the cold fusion device brought to Moldaver by Lucy that can restore power to the ruined city. Maximus and Dane avoid the worst of the firefight outside the observatory, with the former later entering the structure ahead of the main contingent of Brotherhood forces. Maximus is knocked out by [[Hank MacLean]] in a stolen suit of [[T-60 power armor (TV series)|T-60 power armor]] and left there by Lucy and [[the Ghoul]] to be found by Dane shortly after. When Dane discovers the dead body of Moldaver who succumbed to her wounds before they arrived, though Maxmius tries to say he was not responsible, when the other members of the Brotherhood of Steel arrive, Dane uses the opportunity to assert that Maximus dealt the killing blow and credits him with taking down the rebel leader, pushing for him to be granted knighthood for the feat. They raise a chant of "Knight Maximus" as the Brotherhood hails him as a hero, unaware of Maximus' discomfort with the manner of his promotion. ===Season 2=== {{Quotation|Dane is a scribe of the Brotherhood of Steel, and was once Maximus’s closest peer. After surviving the battle against the NCR at Griffith Observatory, Dane was the first to hail Maximus as a Knight for his supposed defeat of Lee Moldaver.|[[Fallout season 2 Amazon overview|''Fallout'' season 2 character description]]}} ====[[The Golden Rule]]==== Dane continues in their duties as a scribe during the San Fernando chapter's mobilization to claim [[Area 51]] as their base of operations. They meet with Maximus as he is polishing his claw-marked suit of T-60 power armor, remarking on Maximus' renewed adherence to the [[Codex]]. Dane tries to remind him of his former goal to reunite with Lucy and the better life he wanted with her, but Maximus asserts that the Brotherhood is the best hope for improving the wasteland. This further concerns Dane, as they change the subject to Quintus' impending meeting with the elders of other Brotherhood chapters, particularly their deliberate exclusion of the [[Brotherhood of Steel (Fallout 4)|Commonwealth chapter]]. The conversation is interrupted by the arrival of the other chapters' airships as Maximus goes to attend. Dane stands among the ranks during the elders' meeting, where they instigate their rebellion against the Commonwealth to return power over the wider Brotherhood back to the West Coast. During this, Dane alerts Maximus to [[Gnatius|Knight Gnatius]] and [[Riley (TV series)|Knight Riley]] playing hot potato with a live [[plasma grenade]], which he then confiscates. In the subsequent celebration, Dane observes as Maximus is challenged to a bare-back duel with a [[Coronado knight|knight]] from the [[Coronado Brotherhood of Steel|Coronado chapter]]. After he kills the knight, Maximus notices Dane's somber expression as they walk away from the violent spectacle. Dane remains nearby to witness the arrival of [[Xander Harkness|Paladin Xander Harkness]], the liaison of the Commonwealth Brotherhood.{{FOTV|2|2}} ====[[The Demon in the Snow]]==== Dane meets Maximus on the flight deck of the ''Caswennan'' after he is brought back from his impromptu "hunting trip" with Xander Harkness, telling him that Quintus is enraged by his action. When Dane sees the paladin (actually [[Thaddeus]] impersonating Xander) awkwardly moving around in his power armor, they deduce right away that something went wrong. Maximus confirms that he killed Xander and Dane wryly responds that the Commonwealth will most certainly be gunning for the West Coast chapters as a result. Maximus claims to have a plan to resolve this, and tells Dane to gather all of the aspirants in a safe place. Confused, Dane is left shocked when Maximus reveals that he plans to kill Quintus to prevent conflict. While Maximus is meeting with Quintus and Thaddeus is off in the cafeteria masquerading as Harkness, Dane leads a group of aspirants (including a [[young aspirant]] whom Maximus mentored earlier) into an empty garage room, warning them not to leave "until the shooting stops." Dane then leaves to sneak into the hangar containing the cold fusion relic and finds it unguarded, allowing them to remove the diode. However, their theft is discovered shortly thereafter by the Grand Canyon elder, causing him to accuse the other elders of being the thieves and inciting all-out conflict between the chapters. Dane navigates the chaos to find Maximus having just locked the still-living Quintus in his chamber. Though Maximus apologizes for having left Quintus alive, Dane consoles him, saying he should not be sad over refusing to take a life, even that of Quintus. Dane gives Maximus the relic, telling him to take it far away from the Brotherhood, saying that they trust Maximus for being the only person at Area 51 who is not a "total asshole." Dane and Maximus hug; Maximus questions what Dane will do, and Dane responds that they'll survive like they always have. While Maximus and Thaddeus subsequently flee, Dane remains behind at the base as the airship fleet launches attacks on each other and sends one crashing into the desert nearby. ====[[The Strip]]==== Amidst the chaos of the civil war started by Maximus' and their own actions, Dane brings Quintus the blueprints for [[Liberty Prime|Liberty Prime Alpha]] and is present when he announces that he now seeks to destroy the Brotherhood, rather than reunify it. ==Personality== [[File:Dane and Maximus.png|thumb|200px|Dane and Maximus looking at power armor]] Dane is shown to be kind towards Maximus, the two of them having a shared dream of being able to don the signature [[T-60 power armor (TV series)|T-60 power armor]] of a knight. However, Dane also lacks foresight in their actions, seemingly unaware that Maximus would be given the blame for their self-inflicted maiming. Dane is also shown to lack the bravery expected in a knight, being frightened by the idea of having to venture into the wasteland to the point of willingly injuring themselves with a razor blade to avoid being sent on missions to the [[Wilds]]. Despite this, Dane seemed to be excited about the idea beforehand, suggesting Dane was merely putting on a brave face in order to gain the respect of their peers, or conforming to the Brotherhood's expectations of its members. Dane later expresses immense guilt when Maximus is falsely announced to be dead. Whereas Maximus is ambitious in wanting to climb the Brotherhood ranks or even leave the Brotherhood to pursue his own agenda, Dane meekly resigns themself to Brotherhood life, and accepts their punishment for their cowardice, even though that means they would be used as cannon fodder in the upcoming battle. After the Battle of Griffith Observatory and Maxmius' ascension to knighthood, Dane expresses concern that their friend is falling deep into the Brotherhood's militaristic dogmatism, hoping to remind him of his former ideal to live a happier life with Lucy, and is concerned to see Maximus participating in the violent spectacle when he is challenged to a fight by a Coronado knight. Their worries for Maximus' fate increase even more after finding out that he was responsible for the death of Xander Harkness and irrevocably set the Brotherhood on the path to civil war, yet Dane remains steadfast as an ally, stealing the cold fusion relic and giving it to Maximus to keep it out of Quintus' hands even as Dane themselves resolves to stay behind while their friend flees. ==Notes== Aspirant Dane is referred to with they/them pronouns by the clergy and could be described as apparently gender non-conforming. ==Notable quotes== * {{Inline quote|There's nowhere safe, Max. And there's no leaving. I wish there was!}} ==Appearances== Dane appears only {{in|FOTV}}. [[Xelia Mendes-Jones]] is credited as part of the main cast during [[Fallout TV series season 1|season 1]], including for episodes in which they do not appear. This is not the case in [[Fallout TV series season 2|season 2]], in which Mendes-Jones is credited as a guest star only on the episodes in which they appear. {{FOTV appearances |1=101 |8=108 |10=202 |12=204 |16=208 }} ==Behind the scenes== * Despite Dane only appearing in two episodes of the first season, Xelia Mendes-Jones is credited as part of the main cast for those episodes. In the second season, Mendes-Jones is credited as a guest star. * Dane's actor, Xelia Mendes-Jones, is a fan of the ''Fallout'' video games and played them before being cast. Xelia said it was a dream come true upon receiving the role. * According to Xelia, Dane is a transmasculine non-binary character, although they prefer being seen as more masculine and are okay with being called a guy. In different interviews, Xelia has used both they/them and he/him[[Xelia Mendes-Jones]]: ''"Dane is always sympathetic to Max and always the best, for him and from him. He wants to see the best version of Max. But I also think that there is a large part of Dane that feels further betrayed by Max disappearing. And I think their conversation when Max returns in episode four, felt like a reckoning of that."''
("[[The Demon in the Snow#Into the Episode|Go Into Episode 4 - Season Two]]") to refer to Dane. **The script of the show itself and character's description on Prime Video refer to Dane with they/them pronouns.[https://www.amazon.com/Fallout-Season-1/dp/B0CN4HV16N ''Fallout'' Season 1 description] ** Dane does not declare their relationship with the gender binary in the text of the script, which does not contain scenes where characters expound upon their gender identity using modern common language. ** Xelia Mendes-Jones is themself transgender and goes by he/they pronouns.[https://www.instagram.com/xeliamj/ Xelia Mendes-Jones' Instagram] Dane is portrayed by non-binary voice actors Alex Delint and Jules Avery in the Latin American Spanish and Dutch dubs of the series, respectively. ** [[File:Dane Polish.jpg|thumb|200px|Dane using explicitly non-binary first person forms in the Polish translation of the series. "Odparłom" (I replied) is a non-binary form; the feminine would be "odparłam" and the masculine would be "odparłem."]]Dane uses explicitly non-binary terms in translations of the series, including Polish (where gender is also marked in the first person), Dutch, Norwegian, Swedish, and Galician. The Latin American Spanish and European Spanish translations of the script do not contain textual evidence of the character's gender whatsoever. * Dane is the fourth character in the [[Fallout series|''Fallout'' series]] to [[LGBT representation in the Fallout series|use they/them pronouns]], following [[Burke (Steel Dawn)|Burke]] and [[Orlando]] from the ''[[Fallout 76]]'' updates ''[[Steel Dawn]]'' and ''[[Expeditions: The Pitt]]'', respectively, and [[Mac Frey|Mackenzie "Mac" Frey]] from ''[[Winter of Atom]]'', a sourcebook for ''[[Fallout: The Roleplaying Game]]''. ==Gallery== Fallout Season 1 Amazon Dane.png|Profile image from Prime Video season 1 character description Fallout Season 2 Amazon Dane.png|Profile image from Prime Video season 2 character description ==References== {{References}} '''Meta''' {{References|group=Meta}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Brotherhood of Steel characters]] [[ru:Послушник Дейн]]
